description: Actual sale prices of flats, houses or building plots near a place in Poland, from notarial deeds (official Rejestr Cen Nieruchomości). Returns median price per m², interquartile range, typical total price and area, breakdown by rooms, yearly trend and recent transactions. place: address "Poznań, Garbary 10", street "Kraków, Długa", town "Swarzędz" or "lat,lon".

examples.description: How many recent transactions to list (default 8)

kind.description: flat = mieszkanie (default), house = dom, plot = działka niezabudowana

market.description: primary = od dewelopera, secondary = rynek wtórny (when recorded)

place.description: Address, street, town or 'lat,lon' in Poland

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres (default 500 for flats, 1500 for houses/plots)

rooms.description: Only flats with this many rooms (5 = 5+)

name: property_prices
title: Real-estate transaction prices (Poland)
